title: TOC line mixing a declared title face with the page number's inherited face: max ascent + max descent
source: tocprobe2-word.pdf (field-free toc 1 paragraphs, 6 per variant, markers between) and mixedface-word.pdf (body paragraphs, 16 variants); Word for Mac direct PDF, pymupdf baselines

cases.note: Century Gothic title, tab and page inherit Calibri: 14.64/14.40 at 10pt x 1.15 vs 14.16/13.92 alone
all runs Century Gothic: 14.16/13.92, nothing to union
tab-only Calibri run with the dot leader does not size the line (14.11): the page run is Century Gothic
Georgia page under a Century Gothic title: recorded, union stays Century Gothic's box (14.11)
Georgia inside Century Gothic's box: Word 14.11 like Century Gothic alone
Calibri covers Times: Word 14.06 = Calibri alone
